fields.summary: Autonomous plan run for change set 01M6ZT7 (bug: review/code fails every run that edits CLI help, settings or the workflow format). The planner read internal/api/run_codecheck.go (checkIn runs runCheck in-process) and internal/api/check.go (DocsWant from docsFiles() and Commands from Operations(), both the running binary's), and found the docs-command rule has the same flaw as the reference staleness check: both judge the branch with the installed binary. One question went to the arbiter: which intent to serve, and how to fix it (skip both rules in the code check; build the worktree's rhiza; or skip only when the build differs). The arbiter decided (code-check-leaves-reference-to-self-check): serve m30-reference, since #412 introduced the regression; the code check turns off the generated-reference comparison and the docs-command rule through an explicit CheckRequest option, plain rhiza check and make self-check keep both, and the code check does not build the worktree's binary. The planner wrote one leaf for that behaviour.
fields.title: Plan: code check leaves the generated reference to self-check
